caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figurine of two human figures, one larger and one smaller, positioned side by side on a rectangular base with rounded corners. The larger figure stands to the left, wearing a long, hooded garment decorated with a repeated pattern of red oval shapes and green stems, suggesting floral motifs. The face of the larger figure is visible, with dark, wide-open eyes, a small nose, and a neutral expression. Next to the larger figure, the smaller figure stands upright and appears to be a child, dressed in a similarly colored but simpler garment. Both figures are rendered in shades of light brown and tan with dark hair and facial features outlined in black or dark brown. The garment of the larger figure is further adorned with green lines and red tulip-like decorations. The pedestal base is depicted in light brown and shaded to suggest a three-dimensional form. The background is plain, with the entire image framed by a thin, dark line creating a rectangular border around the drawing.
title: Pa. German Chalkware Mother and Child
